title: SHADE-Arena Monitor AUC Replicated with Cheap Open Monitors

original_idea.body:
# SHADE-Arena Monitor AUC Replicated with Cheap Open Monitors

**Problem:** On SHADE-Arena, the best monitor (Gemini 2.5 Pro) reached AUC 0.87 at detecting agent sabotage, but whether cheap open-weight monitors can approach this on the released transcripts is unknown.

**Direction:** Using the public SHADE-Arena transcripts (main task + covert side task), replicate the monitoring evaluation but swap in small/open monitor models and a deception-probe monitor. Reproduce the per-task AUC and compare to the reported frontier monitor. Twist: test whether giving the monitor only the action trace vs the full CoT changes the open-monitor AUC, mirroring the CoT-informativeness question on a multi-step agentic setting.

**Why it matters:** Long-horizon agentic sabotage monitoring is a core control problem. Establishing what cheap monitors can catch on a public benchmark is reproducible, lab-free, and immediately useful for deployment planning.

**Relevant context:** SHADE-Arena (arXiv 2506.15740): 17 main/side task pairs, Gemini 2.5 Pro AUC 0.87. CUA-SHADE-Arena extends to VM interaction. Inspect/ControlArena scaffolds exist.
